tasks.title: Cover faucets and drip outdoor taps
tasks.description: Insulate hose bibs and let a trickle run on the most exposed line.

tasks.title: Bring in plants
tasks.description: Move pots inside or cover them before overnight freeze.

tasks.title: Set pool and irrigation freeze mode
tasks.description: Run freeze protect if you have a pool or irrigation controller.

tasks.title: Check the AC filter
tasks.description: A dirty filter during a 105° stretch is how compressors fail.

tasks.title: Close shades on the sunny side
tasks.description: Blackout or close west/south blinds before peak heat.

tasks.title: Set out extra pet water
tasks.description: Fresh water in the shade, indoors and out.

tasks.title: Secure patio furniture
tasks.description: Stack chairs, close umbrellas, and tie down anything that can fly.

tasks.title: Clear drains and gutters
tasks.description: Walk the yard and pull debris from scuppers before the rain hits.

tasks.title: Check the sump pump
tasks.description: Confirm the pump is plugged in and the pit is clear.

tasks.title: Check air purifier and HVAC filters
tasks.description: Replace if dirty and close windows. Recirculate indoor air.

tasks.title: Close vents and check filters
tasks.description: Shut windows, set HVAC to recirculate, and inspect filters after the storm.
